changes.summary: In the fall of 2026, the Museum of Decorative Arts will present Marion Delarue’s works in the Drawings, Wallpapers, and Photographs Gallery, the result of the artist’s residency at the museum. Marion Delarue draws inspiration from the world of ceremonial adornment, which is embodied through her ongoing preoccupations with the body. Her pieces, which constantly question the notion of wearability, play on the blurring of lines between authenticity and imitation, between nature and artifice, exploring the concepts of simulacrum and metamorphosis.
